personality_one_liner: A premium, data-dense operations command center driven by AI, blending tactical utility with a cinematic, glass-layered tech aesthetic.

spacing.rule: Handle spacing correctly dont have extra spaces where its not required, handle padding and margin corectly and subtle for buttons and components

do's: Bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind it
Premium/Featured status overlays on KPI tiles

screens.name: Operations Dashboard
screens.purpose: Role-specific hierarchical overview of active fleet operations and critical KPIs.

states.loading: Skeleton of hero KPI tile and 3 context tiles fading with neural cyan hue.
states.empty: Abstract neural graphic indicating no active operations. CTA to start a new route or shift.
states.error: Readable network error indicating API sync failure with a prominent retry button.

screens.layout: Follow hierarchical KPI structure: Place one large hero tile at the top (e.g., Active Fleet Health), followed by a 2-column grid of 3-4 context tiles (Active Vehicles, Alerts, Tasks). Use Space Grotesk for metrics. Use Electric Blue to Cyan gradients for active states. Maintain dense data layout but use subtle glass overlays for elevation.

screens.name: Assets Registry
screens.purpose: A searchable, virtualized list of all fleet vehicles and operational equipment.

states.empty: Illustration of a modern truck with 'No assets found' message. CTA to Add Asset.
states.error: Error message with a retry connection button.

screens.layout: Virtualized list layout. Each row uses a leading visual (truck icon or photo thumbnail), title (Asset ID/Model), and trailing status chip. Status chips use semantic coloring (e.g., success green for 'Healthy', warning orange for 'Maintenance'). Keep touch targets 44pt+. Include a search bar and pinned filter row.

screens.name: Tracking Map
screens.purpose: Real-time location visualization of fleet assets.

states.loading: Dark mode map skeleton with a central spinner.
states.empty: Map centered on default region with no markers. Prompt to assign trackers.
states.error: Map overlay with 'Location Services Unavailable' and retry CTA.

screens.layout: Full-bleed map interface using a dark mode map style. Cluster assets by default to avoid visual clutter. Prioritize status over identity by coloring pins (green/red). The map acts as an interactive rail with a glassmorphism bottom sheet containing quick details of the selected asset.

screens.name: Financial Overview
screens.purpose: High-level summary of fleet costs, revenue, and efficiency metrics.

states.empty: No financial data for period. Illustration of empty chart with 'Awaiting Data' message.
states.error: Error fetching financial data with retry button.

screens.layout: Stacked metric modules and interactive charts. Large Space Grotesk numbers for revenue and expenses. Use Growth Violet as an accent for financial gains or key insights. Horizontal scrolling for period selection.

screens.name: Menu (More)
screens.purpose: Gateway to Operators, Clients, Contracts, Documents, and Notifications.
screens.layout: Single-column settings-style list. Each row includes a tinted icon container (brandTertiary rounded square) with a Phosphor icon, row title, and trailing chevron. Sections divided by subtle dividers. Includes profile summary at the top with a glass background.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The brand palette is explicitly set by the user: Navy Deep (#0F172A), Electric Blue (#2563EB), Neural Cyan (#06B6D4), and Growth Violet (#7C3AED). Do NOT alter these base hues. Use them for gradients, data-viz, and semantic highlights.
Follow the 'Dark-First Utility' structure but integrate 'Glass / Luxe' surfaces for headers, tabs, and premium featured overlays to achieve the requested 'tech-forward AI identity'.
Use Space Grotesk for metrics and headings (Display) and Plus Jakarta Sans for body text to maintain an advanced geometric look that avoids Inter/Roboto slop.
For the Operations Dashboard layout, implement a hierarchical KPI structure (1 hero tile, 3-4 context tiles) to answer primary operational questions instantly. Pre-aggregate data visually.
For the Assets list, ensure you use virtualized lists and semantic status chips (e.g. green/red for health) instead of generic text.
For Live Tracking, design the map as a full-bleed interactive rail with a glassmorphism bottom sheet overlay for asset details, clustering assets by default.
Implement the Navigation as 4 primary bottom tabs (Operations, Assets, Tracking, Financial) with the 5th tab being a 'Menu' leading to Operators, Clients, Contracts, Documents, and Notifications.
Always apply a top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to #0F172A) over imagery when overlaying text to guarantee readability.
Auth uses Supabase (Google + Apple). Style the login screen using the neural network background image provided, ensuring inputs have strong contrast against the dark background.
